examples.japanese: 食べ終わったら、教えてください。
examples.reading: たべおわったら、おしえてください。
examples.gloss: Tell me when you finish eating.

examples.reading: てがみをかきおわった。

usage: Marks completion of an action that takes time.
Also seen as 終える (transitive): 読み終える.

compare.difference: てしまう says an action is done and often adds regret. 終わる only says it is finished.
始める begins. 終わる ends.
